sloka: स कुम्भकर्णस्य वचो निशम्य व्याविध्य शैलं सहसा मुमोच।तेनाजघानोरसि कुम्भकर्णं शैलेन वज्राशनिसन्निभेन ।। ६.६७.६० ।।
transliteration: sa kumbhakarṇasya vaco niśamya vyāvidhya śailaṁ sahasā mumoca।tenājaghānorasi kumbhakarṇaṁ śailena vajrāśanisannibhena ।। 6.67.60 ।।

translations.english: "O Vanara! You are the grandson of creator Brahma and son of Rksharaja, endowed with fortitude and so roaring like this."
